purpose: The legend entry of one SplitBar series and the toggle that shows or hides it. It names the series and repeats its value in text.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a SplitBar.

Series=1.visual: When Checked, the swatch fills Chart/series-1/solid.

Series=2.visual: When Checked, the swatch fills Chart/series-2/solid.

Series=3.visual: When Checked, the swatch fills Chart/series-3/solid.

Series=4.visual: When Checked, the swatch fills Chart/series-4/solid.

Series=5.visual: When Checked, the swatch fills Chart/series-5/solid.

Series=6.visual: When Checked, the swatch fills Chart/series-6/solid.

Series=7.visual: When Checked, the swatch fills Chart/series-7/solid.

Series=8.visual: When Checked, the swatch fills Chart/series-8/solid.

Checked=true.meaning: The series is shown in the bar (aria-pressed="true").
Checked=true.visual: Swatch in its series colour; label Content/secondary, value Content/primary.

Checked=false.meaning: The series is turned off; the others reflow to 100 %.
Checked=false.visual: Swatch Surface/muted; label and value Content/disabled.

Default.visual: The colours of its Checked value.

Focused.visual: A 2 px ring 1 px off the edge in Border/ring/neutral.

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it; Enter or Space toggles the series.
a11y.reducedMotion: Decided by the motion foundation: the motion roles fall back to the system fade with no travel (design-plans/splitbar-contract.md).
notes: A toggle button with aria-pressed (true = the series is shown).
Swatch, label and value change colour with use-hover (recipes/motion.ts).

openQuestions: Contrast: the off state uses Content/disabled on the page, 3.58:1 in Light and 4.29:1 in Dark, but the button is not disabled (COL-CHART-02). Fix the role or accept?
The last visible series cannot be turned off: how should its legend item show that it is locked, if at all?
